title: Pet owner, wants cooking + 6-month lease
persona: Elena, 33, contractor on a 6-month project. Has a cat.
situation: Three constraints that rarely co-occur in the dataset: pet-friendly, cooking allowed, and a short 6-month lease. Tests graceful handling when few/no listings fully match.

turns.content: I need a place that allows my cat, lets me cook properly, and only for 6 months.
Budget is around $2,000. A room or a small whole unit both work.
Are there really that few options? Which of my requirements is the hardest to meet here?
What would you suggest I compromise on to get more choices?
